## OLIN and HUNTSMAN Announce S-4 Registration Statement in Connection with Planned Merger is
## Effective

Olin Corporation (NYSE: OLN) ("Olin") and Huntsman Corporation (NYSE: HUN) ("Huntsman") announced
that on July 13, 2026, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission declared effective the
registration statement on Form S-4 (the "Registration Statement") filed by Olin in connection with
the previously announced all-stock merger of equals (the "Transaction") to form a combined company,
OlinHuntsman. 

[Learn More][78]

## Huntsman to Discuss Second Quarter 2026 Results on July 31, 2026

We will hold a conference call on Friday, July 31, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET to discuss our second
quarter 2026 financial results. Following opening remarks, the call will move into a question and
answer session.

[Learn More][79]

## Our 2025 Sustainability Report is Here

From innovation to impact- see how we’re advancing solutions that power more sustainable products.

[Read now ][80]

## SHOKLESS™ systems for electric vehicle (EV) batteries
## What’s inside matters…

Developed to encapsulate EV battery cells, our portfolio of polyurethane-based SHOKLESS™ systems are
lightweight, shock-resistant, thermally optimized and structurally strong – supporting OEMs and
battery manufacturers as they work to enhance the next generation of batteries powering EVs.

[Find out more][81]

## Are you looking for solutions to your challenges? Explore our digital portfolio!

Search for products faster by application, chemistry, or performance attributes—with just a few
clicks using our new product finder.

And we want to work with you! Partner with us to scale your innovation and unlock business
opportunities today.

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

any given point of time.

This support will save the time and cost related to emergency transport requirements to avoid rig
shut-downs, or the unnecessary and expensive purchase of regional stocks.

We establish our services as per the requirements of our Customers to ensure the full fledged

Alıcılar İçin Satıcılar İçin

ChemOrder, ihtiyaç duyduğunuz kimyasal, ham madde ve ekipmanları temin etmeniz için kesintisiz ve
verimli çözümler sunarak alıcıları küresel çapta güvenilir tedarikçilerle buluşturur. Platformumuz,
dünya genelinde güvenilir iş ortaklarına erişim, şeffaf fiyat karşılaştırmaları, kolaylaştırılmış
satın alma süreci ve ileri dijital çözümler sağlar. ChemOrder, kimyasal tedarik süreçlerini yeniden
tanımlıyor.

Üstelik alıcı üyeliği %100 ücretsiz!

Şimdi bize katılın ve tedarik deneyiminizi bir üst seviyeye taşıyın.

ChemOrder, işinizi küresel alıcı ağıyla kolayca birleştiren gelişmiş bir platform sunarak
şirketinizi uluslararası ticarete entegre etmenizi ve erişiminizi genişletmenizi sağlar. Masa
başından dünyaya satış yapmaya başlayın ve yüksek çevrimiçi görünürlük elde edin. Telefon
görüşmeleri, fakslar ve ziyaretleri bir kenara bırakın—pazarımızı keşfedin ve yeni fırsatlar
yaratın.

Ham madde satışlarına ek olarak, ekipman satışlarınızı da platformumuzda işlemeye başlayarak avantaj
sağlayın. "Stok Fazlası" ve "Ekipman" gibi özelliklerle portföyünüzü potansiyel alıcılarla
buluşturun ve küresel kimya pazarında kendinize güçlü bir yer edinin.

ChemOrder’a bugün katılın ve işinizi geleceğe taşıyın.

## Why Choose Esteem Industries

### Location

breakthrough research.

### BROAD PRODUCT RANGE

## Who We Are

Esteem is amongst India's leading manufacturer of [Surfactants][14] (also known as surface-active
agents or tensides) and . With over 30 years of experience, we manufacture a comprehensive range of
[Non-Ionic][15], [Anionic][16], Cationic and Amphoteric surfactants. Our surface tension reducing
agents, wetting agents, and emulsifying agents are essential components in various industrial
applications. With a broad spectrum of [chemistries][17] and vast product range (1600+) we meet the
unique requirements of customers and act as a primary supplier for companies, both locally and
internationally.

Under the ownership of Harcros Chemicals Inc, USA, we operate at multiple sites in India, and the
U.S.A. The unique legal entities in India include Esteem Industries Pvt. Ltd. and it's wholly owned
subsidiary Dyna Glycols Pvt. Ltd., besides Grand Organics Pvt. Ltd. and Venus Ethoxyethers Pvt. Ltd.
To cater to the domestic as well as global demand for surfactants and specialty chemical products,
our manufacturing plants in India are strategically located in Goa, Maharashtra and Gujarat. As a
leading chemical manufacturing company, we produce industrial surfactants, specialty chemical
formulations, and custom chemical solutions. With global norms in mind, all our sites are
ISO-9001-2015, ISO-14001-2015, ISO-45001-2018, ISO 20400:2017, ISO-26000:2010, ISO 27001:2022,
ECOVADIS Gold and WASH certified, with a standard SOP firmly in place. Learn more about our
[manufacturing capabilities][18] and [service offerings][19].

These sites are equipped with similar [Ethoxylation][20], [Propoxylation][21], Blending and
[Tolling][22] facilities. With annual capacity exceeding 80,000 MT, Esteem actively operates
multiple reaction vessels with capacities ranging from 100L to 23,000L. These vessels are an
assortment of stainless steel, glass-lined and loop-reactors. Some are also equipped with
distillation facilities. Our chemical processing capabilities include ethoxylation processes,
propoxylation technology, esterification reactions, and custom synthesis services. We serve diverse
industries including [personal care][23], [home care][24], [textile][25], [paper][26], [paint &
coating][27], [agriculture][28], [leather][29], [metal][30], and [oil & gas][31].

## Who We Are

Esteem is amongst India's leading manufacturer of [Surfactants][14] (also known as surface-active
agents or tensides) and . With over 30 years of experience, we manufacture a comprehensive range of
[Non-Ionic][15], [Anionic][16], Cationic and Amphoteric surfactants. Our surface tension reducing
agents, wetting agents, and emulsifying agents are essential components in various industrial
applications. With a broad spectrum of [chemistries][17] and vast product range (1600+) we meet the
unique requirements of customers and act as a primary supplier for companies, both locally and
internationally.

Under the ownership of Harcros Chemicals Inc, USA, we operate at multiple sites in India, and the
U.S.A. The unique legal entities in India include Esteem Industries Pvt. Ltd. and it's wholly owned
subsidiary Dyna Glycols Pvt. Ltd., besides Grand Organics Pvt. Ltd. and Venus Ethoxyethers Pvt. Ltd.
To cater to the domestic as well as global demand for surfactants and specialty chemical products,
our manufacturing plants in India are strategically located in Goa, Maharashtra and Gujarat. As a
leading chemical manufacturing company, we produce industrial surfactants, specialty chemical
formulations, and custom chemical solutions. With global norms in mind, all our sites are
ISO-9001-2015, ISO-14001-2015, ISO-45001-2018, ISO 20400:2017, ISO-26000:2010, ISO 27001:2022,
ECOVADIS Gold and WASH certified, with a standard SOP firmly in place. Learn more about our
[manufacturing capabilities][18] and [service offerings][19].

These sites are equipped with similar [Ethoxylation][20], [Propoxylation][21], Blending and

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What are surfactants and what do they do?

Surfactants are surface-active agents that lower surface tension between liquids, gases, or solids.
They are used in detergents, personal care products, industrial cleaners, and many other
applications. Learn more about [surfactants][46].

### Where are Esteem Industries manufacturing facilities located?

Esteem Industries operates multiple manufacturing facilities strategically located in Goa,
Maharashtra, and Gujarat in India, as well as facilities in the USA. Our total manufacturing
capacity exceeds 90,000 MT annually. Learn more about our [manufacturing capabilities][47].

### What industries does Esteem Industries serve?

We serve diverse industries including [personal care][48], [home care][49], [textile][50],
[paper][51], [paint & coating][52], [agriculture][53], [leather][54], [metal][55], and [oil &
gas][56].

### What certifications does Esteem Industries have?

All our manufacturing facilities are ISO-9001-2015, ISO-14001-2015, ISO-45001-2018, ISO 20400:2017,
ISO-26000:2010, ISO 27001:2022, ECOVADIS and WASH certified, ensuring the highest quality and safety
standards.

### Does Esteem Industries offer custom synthesis and toll manufacturing services?

Yes, Esteem Industries offers comprehensive [custom synthesis and toll manufacturing services][57]
for specialty chemicals. We have expertise in [ethoxylation][58], [propoxylation][59],
[esterification][60], and other chemical processes. Our facilities are equipped with
state-of-the-art QA laboratories operating 24/7.

# ENGINEERS COMMITTED TO INTEGRITY & QUALITY.

## Committed to quality.

The most valuable asset of Integrity is its people. They constantly strive to further the excellence
that has made this company’s success possible. Headquartered in Kingsville, Texas, the company is a
manufacturer of high quality specialty chemical products.

[**LEARN MORE →**][30]

# Committed to quality.

[Integrity-Industries-Industry-Icon.png]

### Stimulation Chemicals

*Frac and Stimulation chemicals for production and completions.
*

[LEARN MORE →][31]

[Integrity-Industries-Oil-Icon.png]

### Safevert

*Invert emulsifiers, thinners, wetting agents, and viscosifiers that have been setting the standard
since 1986.
*

[**LEARN MORE →**][32]

[Integrity-Industries-Industry-Icon.png]

### Synvert

*Emulsifiers and viscosifiers for clean oil systems. Synvert is designed to take on the most

## Surfactants Bringing Chemical Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) to The Next Generation

# Oil Chem **Products**

Oil Chem Technologies is a leader in surfactants and processes for chemical enhanced oil recovery
(EOR) and unconventional gas.

[ [enhanced oil recovery] ][38]

### [ Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) ][39]

Field proven, effective, and economical surfactants for enhanced oil recovery. More than 80 million
ASP surfactants were successfully injected at ultra low concentration. Unique chemistry for high
temperature, high salinity fields.

[Learn More ›][40]

[ [sand-small] ][41]

### [ Water Based Sand Consolidation System ][42]

Control the undesirable sand production from the weak sandstone formation or from the proppant
flowback after fracturing can increase productivity and reduce operating costs. Produced proppants
and formation solids will reduce the production of hydrocarbons and often causes damage to surface
production equipment and downhole pumps.

[Learn More ›][43]

[ [oil recovery eor heavy oil recovery] ][44]

### [ Heavy Oil Recovery ][45]

Effective and economic recovery of heavy oil without steam or solvent. Other mechanical means such
as pulse injection, down-hole gas generation, and heavy oil viscosity reduction can assist the heavy
oil recovery and transport.

[Learn More ›][46]

[ [Nature background. 3D render.] ][47]

### [ Wettability Alteration ][48]

The wetting heterogeneity may affect recovery. In an oil wet or mix wet formation, oil adheres to
the surfaces, resulting in lower oil recovery.  SS-7593 alters the wettability , reduces the
interfacial tension and improves the oil recovery.

[Learn More ›][49]

[ [A vacuum truck used to transport drilling fluids (drilling mud) to the drilling rig site.] ][50]

### [ Damage Removal/Acid Stimulation ][51]

Low concentration of  SS-318 can be added to HCl to enhance the acid stimulation through the matrix.
It further alters the wettability of the formation, reduces the surface tension and reduces the
viscosity of the heavy oil and enhances the oil production.

[Learn More ›][52]

[ ["3D molecular structure isolated on white. DOF effect applied, clipping path included.Similar
images:"] ][53]

### [ Innovative Chemistry ][54]

The one step sulfonation/ alkylation process saves millions of dollars on the manufacturing process.
These products have the sulfonate group on the alkyl chain instead on the benzene ring that improves
the solubility and result in many unique performance properties.

[Learn More ›][55]

## Surfactants Bringing Chemical Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) to The Next Generation

# Oil Chem **Products**

Oil Chem Technologies is a leader in surfactants and processes for chemical enhanced oil recovery
(EOR) and unconventional gas.

[ [enhanced oil recovery] ][38]

### [ Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) ][39]

Field proven, effective, and economical surfactants for enhanced oil recovery. More than 80 million
ASP surfactants were successfully injected at ultra low concentration. Unique chemistry for high
temperature, high salinity fields.

[Learn More ›][40]

[ [sand-small] ][41]

### [ Water Based Sand Consolidation System ][42]

Control the undesirable sand production from the weak sandstone formation or from the proppant
flowback after fracturing can increase productivity and reduce operating costs. Produced proppants
and formation solids will reduce the production of hydrocarbons and often causes damage to surface
production equipment and downhole pumps.

[Learn More ›][43]

[ [oil recovery eor heavy oil recovery] ][44]

### [ Heavy Oil Recovery ][45]

Effective and economic recovery of heavy oil without steam or solvent. Other mechanical means such
as pulse injection, down-hole gas generation, and heavy oil viscosity reduction can assist the heavy
oil recovery and transport.

[Learn More ›][46]

[ [Nature background. 3D render.] ][47]

### [ Wettability Alteration ][48]

The wetting heterogeneity may affect recovery. In an oil wet or mix wet formation, oil adheres to
the surfaces, resulting in lower oil recovery.  SS-7593 alters the wettability , reduces the
interfacial tension and improves the oil recovery.

[Learn More ›][49]

[ [A vacuum truck used to transport drilling fluids (drilling mud) to the drilling rig site.] ][50]

### [ Damage Removal/Acid Stimulation ][51]

Low concentration of  SS-318 can be added to HCl to enhance the acid stimulation through the matrix.
It further alters the wettability of the formation, reduces the surface tension and reduces the
viscosity of the heavy oil and enhances the oil production.

[Learn More ›][52]

[ ["3D molecular structure isolated on white. DOF effect applied, clipping path included.Similar
images:"] ][53]

### [ Innovative Chemistry ][54]

The one step sulfonation/ alkylation process saves millions of dollars on the manufacturing process.
These products have the sulfonate group on the alkyl chain instead on the benzene ring that improves
the solubility and result in many unique performance properties.

[Learn More ›][55]

# PfP Industries

*Oilfield Chemicals, Equipment, & Clean
Water Services Since 1996*

[8/5/2024 Press Release][14]

## Oil Field Chemicals

Specialty chemicals products have become invaluable solutions to problems for oil and gas wells
during fracking. PfP Industries have designed specialty chemicals products that are produced to
enhance the efficiency and production of these wells from acidizing to hydraulic fracturing.

[Oil Field Chemicals][15]

## Stimulation Chemicals

PfP Industries strives to be an industry leader by embracing and employing the latest innovations in
technology, and in so doing, all of our products are designed to be problem-solvers. Our Stimulation
Chemicals product line provides a wide range of fracturing chemicals to help keep your business
running smoothly ...

[Stimulation Chemicals][16]

## Friction Reducer

In order to make the best use of your operations you need a fracturing fluid chemical that minimizes
fluid friction pressure.   PfP Industries offers a variety of Friction Reducers-Suspensions through
their POLYGlide series.  These products are specifically designed to deliver lower pumping pressures
using less...

[Friction Reducer][17]

## Who is PfP Industries and how can we help you?

PfP is a world leader in the supply of Polyacrylamide (FR), Guar, Stimulation Chemicals, & related
products. PFP has been servicing the hydraulic fracturing & oilfield completions industry for over
25 years.

### PfP Around the World

#### Global Capabilities Delivered Locally

[Map of pfp corp. office globally]

### Product - Equipment - Service

#### We're Best Known For

## Oilfield Chemicals

We offer a wide range of chemicals to meet the needs of the oil and gas industry with a focus on the
fracking and acidizing side of the business.

[Oilfield Chemicals][18]

## Oilfield Equipment

We have spent significant resources on R&D for the designing and manufacturing of patented equipment
solutions for both Dry and Liquid FR's, Dry Guar and other liquid additives.

[Oilfield Equipment][19]

## Water Clean-up Systems

We recognize the importance and necessity to do our part in water clean-up systems, and we have
developed proprietary processes and equipment to conduct water clean-up projects.

[Water Clean-up Systems][20]

**Zirax** is one of the leading global companies in the development, production and trading of
calcium chloride and specialty chemicals.

**Zirax** operates in five main production areas:
* [Solutions for oil & gas industry][45]
* [De-icing solutions][46]
* [Industrial solutions][47]
* [Food additives][48]
* [Surfactants][49]

Zirax was established in 2002 in Russia and currently has more than 350 professionals working in
various areas, from production and R&D to marketing and service. Over the years, Zirax became an
international player it  included scientific laboratories, manufacturing facilities, our raw
material quarry for calcium chloride production and oil & gas services company.

This provides for best possible quality control via the whole process chain to produce the final
material for our existing and new customer globally, including tailor made solutions for particular
purposes, which need the most careful treatments. Being a customer orientated  company we develop
our technologies and production sites to produce our chemicals at most reasonable cost with minimum
effect to local environment.


# Zirax is one of the leading international chemical groups operating at Oil & Gas, De-icing, Food
# and Industrial business segments.

  12/10/2022

#### Attention! Beware of counterfeits!

**Dear customers!**

Due to recent cases of counterfeits of our trademark E-509 food grade calcium chloride Fudix
appearing in the marketplace, we do ask you to double check the goods’ origin and manufacturer in
case you buy Fudix through a dealer.

Original Fudix is packed in textured 25 kg polypropylene bags with a self-sealing valve on the side.
There is a double-sided seal and product description in multiple languages. The original product is
thermo-sealed and has a clearly marked batch number and expiry date.

You can email [export@zirax.com][51] to check the authenticity of your batch number and packaging.

We wish you and your families health, happiness and a very prosperous upcoming year!

Merry Christmas and a happy of New Year!

Have a great holiday!
